# No frontmatter

Saving this document must not add a YAML block or timestamp fields.

| Feature | Example |
| --- | --- |
| Math | $x^2$ |
| Formatting | **bold**, *italic*, ==highlight== |

> A quote with `updated: literal` and a note[^note].

- List item.

```yaml
created: literal
updated: literal
```

[^note]: A footnote without frontmatter.
